Running-text computations that are not stated as results (the derivation before (8), the trace-formula computation for beta before (9)) stay unextracted text.
Numbered equation (6) was retyped as an external theorem because the text introduces it as [MR3249829, Lemma 2.1]. Keeping it as an equation was the alternative.

The sigma-module unique-unit-root statement in the second intro Remark could be a claim or an external theorem. The remark points to the authors' earlier paper for it and the paper re-proves it inline, so it is an external theorem with a paper proof PP1.
These definitions also assert a mapping property (alpha_m maps C_0(O_0) to C_0(O_{0,p^m}); beta is completely continuous) in the same sentence. They were kept as definitions.

Theorems 3.1 and 4.5 are argued in running text before them. Each prose proof runs from the first sentence after the last preceding equation or claim up to the lead-in colon ('we have:' / 'we have shown:'). The definitions of beta^(m) and of the dual Fredholm determinant inside those spans are proof steps.

The proof of Theorem 1.1 is the final 'Unit root formula' paragraph of Section 5. It rests on the eigenvector construction across Section 5 and on Theorems 3.1 and 4.5. Its first part (analytic continuation of F) comes from the cited result TP10.
These definitions end at a display that has no closing period. The node ends at the display.

\begin{align*}
\beta_{\kappa, \bar t, \Lambda}^* \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa &= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \circ \Phi_\lambda^{a d(\bar t)} \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x))^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \circ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa  \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \Upsilon \left( h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x)  \right)^l \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \sum_{l=0}^\infty \binom{\kappa}{l} \left(\Upsilon \circ \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 \right)^{\kappa - l} \left(\Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^l \qquad \text{by definition of $ [\alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^*]_\kappa$} \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \> \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \cdot 1 + \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* h(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \left( \Upsilon \circ  \alpha_{a d(\bar t), \Lambda}^* \eta(\Lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, \lambda^{q_{\bar t}}, x) \right)^\kappa \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \left( \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x) + \Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x)  \right)^\kappa \qquad \text{by } (\ref{E: first formula}) \\
&= \text{pr}_{M(\Gamma)} \>  \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa \left( 1 + \frac{\Upsilon(\omega(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}{\Upsilon( \eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))}  \right)^\kappa \\
&= \c F_{a d(\bar t)}(\Lambda)^\kappa \Upsilon(\eta(\Lambda, \lambda, x))^\kappa.
\end{align*}
